title: W14 retention inputs — W10 aggregate and W17 boundary

conditions.description: Read-only refresh only; do not edit JobManager, run implementation tests, or claim pruning authority. W10 accepted source 2232c93001cdad7079d8776c4229613e25ef6e0c is already included as second parent of mechanical merge 2adc1e88e039da5708fad5a3ec55f5c3eeadaf83, which is parent of corrected W7 commit 89d9e38531869ca6f4fa4e514f9d2f4ed13e51a1. The entire corrected composition was independently Accepted by Reviewer 7 (review d2e83f178d544b2f97a34adbe7a85f6e) and integrated to main seq20490 via verified non-force publication. W10 standalone submission remains Pending but must not be merged separately; historical IncludedInAggregate disposition is a reviewer-owned follow-up. W17 owns typed Create/event-registration admission and reservation/reconciliation/release. Exact W17 correction 1e1ed907e5d0cbf7e5eef325fc563c412342aaae has task-bound Accepted review 5b9c9679c45346c6bfb8f0dfcbed0778 seq20746; candidate 115e4d0468b12e33206bdef8a0d1c216e1172ca5 on W7 main passed 86/86 scoped registered-route gates but is not published. W7 diagnostic/full Client+Server qualification remain HOLD; Scheduler OFF. Refresh the W14 test matrix: 100-item/7-day expiry, completion-before-registration, multiple conditions, cancel/unknown, wrong actor/project, restart, duplicate/reorder and bounded capacity. Preserve reservations across uncertain create/retry/restart; release only after verified retirement of all linked conditions and definitive nonpublication. Never infer success from absence, age, failed send or lost hint. W14 owns retention storage/prune and tests only; no code or test execution until W17 integration and a separate Lead implementation GO. No activation/deployment.
conditions.evidence: Read-only retention input refresh against challenge v1 at ledger 200091db61aaef5408771616666a09f1e8b5b1a2; task spec blob 85be9e01d7cc27b7271d3313f97cd601102c432d. Integrator records W10 2232c93001cdad7079d8776c4229613e25ef6e0c included via 2adc1e88e039da5708fad5a3ec55f5c3eeadaf83 and W7 89d9e38531869ca6f4fa4e514f9d2f4ed13e51a1, Accepted d2e83f178d544b2f97a34adbe7a85f6e, published seq20490; no separate W10 merge. W17 owns typed Create, admission, reservation/reconciliation/release; W14 owns local durable bounded retention metadata/pruning only. Refreshed test matrix (not executed): (1) unreserved receipts retain existing 100-item/7-day behavior; exact reserved terminal identity survives both cutoffs independently of output expiry, including restart; (2) job completion before canonical registration and between reservation/create, receipt remains available across disconnect/restart and uncertain publication/retry; acquisition versus terminal pruning serialized, failure/expiry before valid reservation fails closed; (3) multiple conditions per job, duplicate/reordered registration and retirement are idempotent; one condition retiring cannot release the others; (4) canceled job retains exact terminal outcome, unknown/missing evidence never implies success or reconstructs a receipt; (5) actor/project/job mismatch cannot acquire/reconcile/release another identity, wrong scope cannot authorize pruning; (6) persistence/restart preserves reservations and terminal identity, uncertain/corrupt state fails closed rather than unpins; (7) bounded admission rejects new reservations when full, never evicts live pins, output and active job bounds unchanged, definitively retired evidence eligible for normal pruning; (8) release only after verified retirement of all linked conditions and definitive nonpublication of outstanding create/retry paths; age, lost hint, failed send, absence and unknown are not proof. W7 diagnostic and full Client+Server qualification HOLD, Scheduler OFF. No implementation, tests, pruning authority, activation or deployment undertaken. Await verified W17 integration and separate Lead implementation GO before isolated source binding or code.
